items.m: Someone was looking for you just now.
He's only been in China for three weeks.
Did you understand the question just now?
I'd only just got home when someone came round.
Sorry, I didn't hear you just now.
We've only known each other for two months.
What did you say just now?
My little sister only started work last month.

items.a: 我在开会，所以没有接你的电话。
items.m: I was in a meeting just now, so I didn't answer your call.
He's just got home from work.
I didn't see him just now.
He's only been in China for a year.
Who was that on the phone just now?
I didn't have my phone with me just now.
